gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Expose packs its lowercase tight against its capitals, a compressed, hurried display face with almost no pause between letters. Noto Sans Old Turkic is the sans-serif that follows, chunky and open-curved; size it a touch generously.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Contemporary and friendly, Noto Sans Oriya keeps its curves generous and its small letters nearly as tall as the capitals. Expose sits above it, striking and compressed, so the page feels tight on top and open below.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-osage: Approachable from the first line, Expose still looks refined, its letters packed close with barely a breath between them. Noto Sans Osage replies with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves that never close up, and that fullness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Expose is defined by its compressed cadence, where lowercase nearly reaches the capitals and hardly any pause breaks the rhythm. Noto Sans Osmanya brings wide, easy s shapes and oversized lowercase, and a slightly modest size suits that plain sans.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Tight, striking and refined, that is Expose, with lowercase crowding right up to the capitals. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong follows with a high-set x-height and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, which keeps a long passage moving smoothly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Expose barely lets its lowercase drop below the capitals, giving the display lines a compressed, quick-stepping cadence that feels striking and refined. Noto Sans Palmyrene is a clean sans-serif whose curves stop short, so a long passage reads lightly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Expose crowds its lowercase almost up to the capital line, which gives it a compressed, striking pace with very little pause. And Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau loosens everything, its open-ended curves breathing beside that tightness.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Expose is compressed, striking and refined. Noto Sans PhagsPa sits under it with see-through c openings and a gentle step up to the capitals, so tight display lines hand off to a softer, friendlier text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Expose runs tight, refined and strikingly compressed. Noto Sans Phoenician has generous lowercase height and s curves open at both ends, so a long passage feels modern and unhurried.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahla: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi reads approachably, with gaping mouths on the e and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Expose's compressed, striking lines against that softness are the pair's strongest quality.
